Q6111.reason: Under O'Brien, a content-neutral littering ordinance that serves park cleanliness and is not aimed at suppressing the message may be applied to symbolic protest conduct.

Q8473.reason: Hektoen enteric agar grows non-lactose-fermenting H2S-producing Salmonella and Shigella, so a positive culture identifies Salmonella typhi rather than C. difficile or the protozoa.

Q5467.reason: An unintended killing caused by the unlawful act of speeding is involuntary manslaughter, with neither intent to kill nor malice aforethought.
